_source: Hand-entered 2026-11-22 from estate-inheritance-taxes.html (Tax Foundation, as of October 1, 2026): each exemption and rate range, which states index exemptions (CT, ME, NY, RI, DC), and where the top rate starts (HI $10M, WA $9M, MN and NY $10.1M). Elsewhere the top rate is taken to start at $10.04M, the top of the old federal state death tax credit table (IRC 2011) the 0.8%-16% states use. Between the exemption and that point the model raises the rate evenly from the lowest to the top rate: an approximation of each state's own brackets. Inheritance tax rates by heir class are each state's statutory class rates (PA 4.5% lineal, 12% siblings, 15% others; NE 1% over $100,000, 11% over $40,000 for collateral relatives, 15% over $25,000 others, siblings in the 1% class; NJ and KY exempt children, siblings at 11% and 4% at the low end, others 15% and 6%; MD exempts children and siblings, others 10%).
